# 39f0e9aeb156a61c (indirect_diffuse_lighting:CS_ScreenProbes_ActivateRays, CS wave32) - size of our DXIL

Offline, d13s 67f6472 + 007ad6b (fix/described-smem), VICTORY_ROOT_UAVS=1. Translation itself: 2.6 s in the
device VM (whole pedtool run incl. reading the rpf). Numbers only.

## Console program
- 74,594 instructions, code 0x51718 bytes (~333 KB).
- 1,377 far jumps: s_getpc_b64 + s_add_u32 lit + s_addc_u32 + s_setpc_b64 to 86 distinct targets;
  the top 3 take 1,045 of them: 0x2a068 (386), 0x50708 (346), 0x29a10 (313); then 0x4e038 (27),
  0x4ec08 (20), 0x50228 (14). Shared tail blocks. No s_swappc (no real calls).
- Branches: 4,136 s_cbranch_scc1, 1,665 scc0, 2,521 vccz, 1,665 vccnz, 1,899 s_branch, 10 execz
  -> almost all uniform (scalar) control flow.
- Backward branches (loops): 0x244->0x1d0, 0x780->0x420, 0x790->0x418, 0x9e8->0x9b8, 0x2380->0x22b0,
  0x2f1c/0x3b6c->0x1bc8, 0xe458->0xdbc8, 0x1400c->0xec78 (5,349 words), 0x14d20->0xf8e0 (5,392 words).
- Memory ops: 2,453 s_load_dwordx4, 1,889 buffer_load_format_x, 31 s_load_dwordx8, 27 image_load,
  9 buffer_store_format_xyzw, 37+12+11+2 s_buffer_load, 6 ds_read, 2 image_sample_lz, 2 image_gather4_lz.
  (Looks like per-ray / per-material code expanded many times: thousands of descriptor loads.)

## Our DXIL (1,090,184-byte container, bitcode 1,089,868 bytes, one function)
- Basic blocks: 22,337. Median block = 1 instruction; 14,006 blocks have <= 3 instructions.
- Instructions: 125,210: 32,149 binop, 24,204 cmp, 22,334 br (10,016 conditional, 12,318 unconditional),
  19,399 call (dx.op), 10,950 select, 5,776 cast, 5,750 phi, 4,589 extractvalue, 19 load, 18 store,
  16 gep, 1 alloca, 0 switch.
- Phis: 5,750, average 3.8 incoming; histogram 2:3341, 3:632, 4:1007, 5:286, 6:175, 7:72, 8:124, >=9:113.
  Two giant joins: block 22267 has 1,932 predecessors and block 11307 has 1,926 (one phi each with
  >50 incoming, up to 1,932), block 11302 has 964 predecessors. Most likely the top far-jump targets
  (0x2a068 / 0x50708 / 0x29a10) plus paths into them (not mapped block-by-block).
- Back edges (loops) = 11, as (from block -> header, span in blocks):
  10->2 (8), 25->18 (7), 26->17 (9), 39->39 (0), 22269->11314 (10,955), 22279->11485 (10,794),
  22280->225 (22,055), 22288->22285 (3), 22291->53 (22,238), 22309->22308 (1), 22326->22305 (21).
  So two outer loops cover nearly the whole function (225..22280 and 53..22291), with two ~11k-block
  loops inside; each has our loop-limit counter phi.
- 10 biggest blocks (block index: instructions): 54:697, 11314:567, 21:503, 46:338, 22317:331,
  22330:317, 16:308, 22271:306, 11400:297, 140:271.

## What looks heavy for a driver
- 22k blocks with ~2k-predecessor joins inside 2-level loops spanning the whole function: that is the
  worst case for SSA/regalloc in the AMD compiler. The far-jump tails being merged into 2-3 blocks with
  ~1.9k preds each is the standout.
- Ideas: duplicate (tail-copy) the small far-jump targets instead of merging all 1,377 jumps into one
  join; or lower the far jumps as a "goto exit" with a flag + one branch so the join has few preds.
- Not done: DXC validation / CreateComputePipelineState timing (no dxc or D3D12 in the cloud or VM).
